page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-72-lssd is an Arm64-based server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs and 288.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes local NVMe SSD storage, while omitting any dedicated GPU hardware.

Operating on the arm64 architecture, this instance offers high resource density for multi-threaded workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the Arm-based architecture provides an efficient performance-per-watt profile, making it a viable option for scale-out workloads that require substantial memory and compute resources without the premium associated with traditional architectures or GPU accelerators.

The c4a-standard-72-lssd is designed for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded applications, database deployments utilizing local NVMe SSD storage, web serving, and containerized microservices that benefit from a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
